patterns.note: A two-column grid layout is consistently used for article listings on the homepage, transitioning to a single-column layout for individual article pages, maintaining a clear content hierarchy.
Prominent, large sans-serif headings are used for the site title and article titles, creating strong visual anchors, while body text and metadata use a more standard, highly readable sans-serif.

A deep, dark blue/black (#0b0f1e) serves as the dominant background, providing a 'cosmic' feel, contrasted with light, almost white text (#e8f0fe) and subtle blue and yellow accents for links and category tags.
A fixed header bar remains persistently at the top of the viewport, displaying the site title and a tagline, as the main content scrolls underneath it without any other scroll-triggered animations.
Article cards feature a full-bleed image at the top, followed by a small, uppercase category tag, a bold title, a brief description, and a date, all contained within a subtly rounded dark card.

technique_notes: Implement a fixed position header element that remains at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, allowing content to scroll underneath it without any visual transformation.

Design article cards with a dark background and subtle corner rounding. Place a full-width image at the top, followed by text content including an uppercase category label, a prominent title, a summary, and a date.

Utilize a deep, dark blue as the primary background color, with light, high-contrast text for readability. Use lighter blue tones for interactive elements and accents to maintain a sophisticated dark theme.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (site title ~3-4x body, article titles ~1.5-2x body) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by a readable sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing in the hero and between major sections, and a more compact but readable spacing within article cards.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, dark, almost cosmic color palette combined with crisp, modern typography and high-quality astronomical imagery creates an immersive and sophisticated editorial experience, making it feel like a premium digital magazine for space enthusiasts.
